    Profile

    A quiet blacksmith who wandered into the Sephira Village from the Avaritia Belt Region. He is very assiduous when it comes to the perfection of his craft, dedicating his life to the weapons he forges. He loves the sparks that fly as he forges weapons, and aspires to one day create a weapon that could be considered the materialization of a soul.

    Origin: Avaritia Belt Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 179cm
    Weight: 72kg
    Birthday: Nov 4
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunder Beast
    Likes: Anvil sparks
    Hobbies: Gathering raw materials
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 新祐樹
